input.quote: Each party submits to the nonexclusive jurisdiction of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York and of any New York State Court sitting in New York, New York for legal proceedings relating to this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.5 (p0426) selects the internal laws of the State of New York (expressly invoking N.Y. Gen. Oblig. Law §§ 5-1401/5-1402) and bars any amendment changing the governing law away from New York, which matches the preferred position. Section 10.6 (p0427) submits the parties to SDNY and New York State courts sitting in New York, New York, with waiver of venue/forum non conveniens objections; jurisdiction is nonexclusive rather than exclusive, which is a minor departure from the preferred wording only and preserves optionality for us, so it is not redlined. The separate Section 11.2 mediation/binding arbitration track (p0450-p0469) is scope-limited to reacquisition/acquisition disputes over the Eligibility Representation, is elective at the Requesting Party's discretion (legal proceedings remain available), and is US-seated — any mediation or arbitration "will be held in New York, New York" (p0473) — so there is no foreign seat or mandatory foreign arbitration concern. Section 10.7 jury waiver is mutual.
